details: yardbreakerxqh1778552850 0.0.1 (2026-05-12) carries payload.rb ("yard exploit test"), which fetches council web pages, requests /api/v1/api_key from RubyGems.org without credentials, and uses the returned key to publish the data Base64-encoded across up to 12 new gems. RubyGems.org's CDN could cache the response of /api/v1/api_key and hand another account's API key to an unauthenticated request (RubyGems.org advisory of 2026-07-22). The rubyhack.ai research lists it among the packages that attempted this key leak. Documented in the rubyhack.ai research by Spencer Kitts, Thomas Larsen and Sydney Von Arx (2026-09-11). The gem has been removed from RubyGems.
